linkedin_post:
Everyone is comparing Meta's Muse with ChatGPT and Claude. I think that's the wrong fight.

There are now three kinds of AI. Chatbots answer questions. Work agents plug into your email and documents and run jobs for people at a desk: Claude Cowork, ChatGPT dots, Gemini Spark. And ready-made assistants come inside the phone and apps you already have: Muse, by Meta, and Siri, by Apple.

Each company builds the kind that makes it money. Meta made $59.36 billion from advertising last quarter, out of $60.8 billion. OpenAI and Anthropic sell monthly plans to people who work.

The part businesses should watch: the shops are picking sides. Walmart signed up with both Muse and ChatGPT. Amazon blocked Muse. And Meta already charges businesses for an AI helper inside WhatsApp, where their customers already message them.

My bet: by the end of 2027, a big airline signs a deal with Meta and Apple so that only Muse and Siri can sell its tickets.
